02 / MODEL SETTINGS

Make the assumptions explicit.

Defaults come from the IXN notebooks. Adjust them for your site and soil profile.

Soil moisture must represent the full configured profile. Raw PR2 readings are percentages at 6–36 inches; when the standard depth settings are in place, the analysis matches the model profile to the measured 0.9144 m depth. Field capacity and wilting point below are fractions (m³/m³).

Input coverage & assumptions

Take the analysis with you.

Excel workbook, CSV tables, PDF/PNG figures, daily records and a reproducible run manifest.

WB_ETa combines measured water balance and modeled fallback. Load covers paired valid nitrate dates only. Nitrogen mass is available only with a confirmed NO₃ / NO₃-N basis.

Field data. Explicit assumptions. Reproducible results.

Prepare your inputs

Use CSV files or XLSX files with column names exactly as shown. One combined workbook can contain Weather, Irrigation, Nitrate, Moisture and Plots sheets.

Weather is daily and continuous, with dew point or both humidity extrema. Include preplant history (the original raw workflow starts April 1). Irrigation is a complete event log; unlisted days are zero. Moisture accepts the five raw PR2 VWC percentages from Master_PR2_SM.xlsx (Westport sheet), or a complete profile storage value in millimeters. Nitrate is solution concentration, not soil or plant nitrogen.

Only the weather and irrigation tables are required. Without nitrate, load stays missing. Without complete moisture profiles, WB_ETa uses modeled fallback. Resolve duplicate plot/date measurements before upload.
